dct_creator_sm: Fillery, Mark (Canadian Memorial Chiropractic College). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7014-995X
dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains de-identified demographic and professional registration information
for 4,185 chiropractors registered to practice in Ontario, Canada, between 1996 and 2007.
The data were obtained from the College of Chiropractors of Ontario (CCO) and subsequently
verified against publicly available membership directories to ensure accuracy and
completeness . The dataset was compiled to support a longitudinal analysis examining the
intended and unintended consequences of the delisting of chiropractic services from the
Ontario Health Insurance Plan.

The dataset includes five core variables describing practitioner characteristics and
professional status over time: year of graduation, school of graduation, sex, registration
status, and geographic location. Registration status reflects practitioner activity levels
and has been harmonized into three categories (active, inactive, and retired) from the
original classifications provided by the CCO. Geographic information, originally recorded
as postal codes, has been converted into Local Health Integration Network (LHIN) regions
to preserve analytical value while ensuring participant anonymity . All variables were
separated into individual files and linked through anonymized identifiers to further
enhance confidentiality protections. The dataset does not include outcome variables or
analytical results but provides the foundational demographic and structural information
used for longitudinal analyses, including workforce dynamics, retention, and regional
distribution of chiropractors.
